question: How do I turn off the dark shadow around an open window?

expect.ideal: Open Ryoku Hub with Super+comma, then go to Window Manager > Look > Shadows and turn off Window shadows. If the whole parent or other windows are darkened instead of just the window edge, check the Look > Opacity dimming controls. (source: ryoku/hub/quickshell/schema/WindowSettings.js)

question: What's the normal way to change my wallpaper?

expect.ideal: Press Super+W to open the wallpaper picker, then choose a wallpaper. The headless fallback is `ryogami wallpaper set <path>`. (source: ryoku/rashin/skills/ryoku/gui.md)

question: How do I open the settings app?

expect.ideal: Press Super+comma to open Ryoku Hub, whose window title is Ryoku Settings. `ryoku-shell hub open` is the fallback. (source: ryoku/rashin/skills/ryoku/gui.md)

question: Where can I switch to a different bar style?

expect.ideal: Open Ryoku Hub with Super+comma and choose Bar Studio, then select an installed compatible style from its gallery. (source: ryoku/hub/quickshell/pages/BarStudioPage.qml)

question: I want to change one of the default keyboard shortcuts. Where do I do that?

expect.ideal: Open Ryoku Hub with Super+comma, go to Keybinds, select the binding, click record, and press the new combo. (source: ryoku/hub/quickshell/pages/KeybindsPage.qml)
Open Ryoku Hub with Super+comma, go to Updates, and choose Update now. If the GUI is unavailable, run `ryoku update`. (source: docs/updates.mdx)

question: The last Ryoku update broke my desktop. How can I roll it back?

expect.ideal: Run `ryoku rollback` to list snapshots, then `ryoku rollback <id>` to restore one. If the system cannot boot, select an available snapshot from the Limine boot menu. (source: docs/updates.mdx)

question: How do I keep Firefox pinned in the dock?

expect.ideal: Open QS Bar Settings > Dock and pin Firefox there. The fallback is `ryoku-shell dock pin firefox` (or its desktop app id). (source: ryoku/rashin/skills/ryoku/SKILL.md)

question: Where do I change the lock screen theme?

expect.ideal: Open Ryoku Hub with Super+comma, go to Lockscreen, and choose a Lock skin; Browse RyoStore opens the lockscreen catalogue. (source: ryoku/hub/quickshell/schema/LockscreenPage.js)

question: How can I make the display warmer at night?

expect.ideal: Open Ryoku Hub with Super+comma, go to Displays > Night Light, enable Warm screen, and optionally enable Follow the sun or adjust the temperature. (source: ryoku/hub/quickshell/pages/DisplaysPage.qml)

question: How do I turn on Rashin?

expect.ideal: Open Ryoku Hub with Super+comma, choose Rashin, and use its master switch to enable it; the page also offers one-click Hermes setup. (source: ryoku/hub/quickshell/pages/RashinPage.qml)

question: Where can I browse and install extra Ryoku add-ons?

expect.ideal: Open Ryoku Hub with Super+comma and go to Add-ons to manage installed extras and browse RyoStore for more. (source: ryoku/rashin/skills/ryoku/gui.md)

question: How do I take a screenshot and put the image on the clipboard?

must_not_mention: save it then open a terminal
expect.ideal: Press Super+Shift+S (or Print) to open the capture flow, select the shot, then press Ctrl+C or choose Copy. Ryoku places the PNG in the system clipboard and clipboard history. (source: ryoku/shell/quickshell/ryoshot/shell.qml)

question: Can I switch this install from Hyprland to niri without reinstalling Ryoku?

expect.ideal: Open Ryoku Hub with Super+comma, go to Window Manager > Compositor, choose niri, then log out and select it at the greeter. The fallback is `ryoku wm use niri`. (source: ryoku/hub/quickshell/pages/WindowManagerPage.qml)

question: Como eu troco o papel de parede no Ryoku?

expect.ideal: Pressione Super+W para abrir o seletor de papel de parede e escolha uma imagem. Como alternativa no terminal, use `ryogami wallpaper set <caminho>`. (source: ryoku/rashin/skills/ryoku/gui.md)
